import numpy as np,json
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
s=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'));m=json.load(open('/app/output/initial/meta.json'))
p=np.array(m['proprio']['now']);q=p[:7]
origins=[([0,0,.333],[0,0,0]),([0,0,0],[-np.pi/2,0,0]),([0,-.316,0],[np.pi/2,0,0]),([.0825,0,0],[np.pi/2,0,0]),([-.0825,.384,0],[-np.pi/2,0,0]),([0,0,0],[np.pi/2,0,0]),([.088,0,0],[np.pi/2,0,0])]
T=np.eye(4);T[:3,:3]=R.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix();T[:3,3]=[0,-.4,.78]
for (xyz,rpy),v in zip(origins,q):
 A=np.eye(4);A[:3,:3]=R.from_euler('xyz',rpy).as_matrix();A[:3,3]=xyz
 B=np.eye(4);B[:3,:3]=R.from_euler('z',v).as_matrix();T=T@A@B
A=np.eye(4);A[:3,:3]=R.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix();A[:3,3]=[0,0,.107];T=T@A
print('hand',T,'observed',p[16:23],sep='\n')
O=np.eye(4);O[:3,:3]=R.from_quat(p[[20,21,22,19]]).as_matrix();O[:3,3]=p[16:19]
print('hand to observed',np.linalg.inv(T)@O)
for cam,pts in {'forward':[(210,70),(200,125),(230,125),(220,20),(100,150),(175,145),(50,142),(253,70)],'right':[(242,81),(239,110),(264,81)]}.items():
 d=np.load('/app/output/initial/depth_'+cam+'.npy')[-1];cs=s['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(cs['intrinsic_cv']);C=np.array(cs['cam2world_gl'])
 print(cam,d.shape)
 for u,v in pts:
  z=float(d[v,u]);pt=C@np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1]);print((u,v),z,pt[:3])
